pages.name: Benoni: 6.e4 g6 7.Bd3 Bg7 8.h3
pages.notes: Plan 1 rerouted Nf3-e1-g2 and Nf1-g3 with no knights on f3 or f1; plan 3 had White controlling e4 (own pawn); plan 4 sent a knight from d7 to c7. Rewrote plans 1, 3, 4; British spelling.

pages.name: Benoni: 6.e4 g6 7.Bd3 Bg7 8.Nge2
pages.notes: Plan 2 played ...Na6-c7 after ...a6; plan 1 had an e2-knight going to f4 alongside f2-f4. Rewrote both plans; British spelling.

pages.name: Benoni: 6.e4 g6 7.Bf4
pages.notes: Plan 1 pushed f2-f4 with the bishop on f4; plan 3 routed Nf3-d2-e4 onto White's own e4-pawn. Rewrote plans 1 and 3; British spelling.

pages.name: Benoni: Saemisch (6.e4 g6 7.f3)
pages.notes: Plan 3 read control of f5 as a move. Rewrote plan 3; British spelling.

pages.name: Benoni: Saemisch, 8.Bg5
pages.notes: Plan 1 pushed g4-g5 with the bishop on g5; plan 2 played ...Na6-c7 after ...a6 and called it a knight from f6. Rewrote both plans; British spelling.

pages.name: Benoni: Saemisch, 8.Bg5 h6
pages.notes: Plan 2 played ...Na6-c7 after ...a6; plan 1 rewritten around Be3/Bh4, Qd2, Nge2, g4 and h4. British spelling.

pages.name: Benoni: Saemisch, 8.Bg5 h6 9.Be3 O-O 10.Nge2
pages.notes: Overview and plan 1 relied on an f4-f5 push with the pawn on f3 and on castling with the bishop on f1; plan 3 rerouted ...Na6-c7. Rewrote overview phrase and plans 1 and 3; British spelling.

pages.name: Benoni: Saemisch, 8.Bg5 h6 9.Be3 O-O 10.Qd2 a6
pages.notes: Plan 2 developed the knight via ...Na6-c7 with a pawn on a6. Rewrote plan 2; British spelling.

pages.name: Benoni: Saemisch, 8.Bg5 h6 9.Be3 O-O 10.Qd2 a6 11.a4 Nbd7
pages.notes: Plan 1 castled with the bishop on f1; plan 2 used a ...Nf8-e6 route instead of the e5-square. Rewrote plans 1-2; British spelling.

pages.name: Benoni: Saemisch, 8.Bg5 h6 9.Be3 O-O 10.Qd2 a6 11.a4 Re8
pages.notes: Plan 1 used Be3-h6 into a pawn on h6; plan 3 played Kh1 with the king on e1; plan 4 read the g4 advance as a move. Rewrote plans 1, 3, 4; British spelling (centre, fuelled).
